QuestInfo.name: Explorer Awakening
QuestInfo.0: A strange energy pulses through you, making you feel lighter and stronger. See what Empress Cygnus has to say.
QuestInfo.1: A strange energy pulses through you, making you feel lighter and stronger. See what Empress Cygnus has to say.
QuestInfo.2: After awakening the power of her Alliance members, the Empress undertakes a dangerous mission to enhance the power of the Maple Alliance as a whole. On a silent dawn in Ereve, the Explorers and Cygnus Knights find themselves awakening to their true potential.

0.0: #h0#, did you feel your aura expanding?\r\n#L0##bAre you Empress Cygnus? D-did something happen to me?#l\n#k
0.1: My first act to boost the Maple Alliance was to awaken the inner strength of the lost Heroes and the members of the Resistance. I, too, underwent a transformation, though it was not my intent. \r\n#L0##bI heard about that. What have you done to me? I feel... #l\n#k
0.2: Is it not familiar, like the brisk gasp of air as you break the water's surface? That is the strength inside you awakening. At the break of dawn, when the moon's light still fully enveloped Ereve, I reached out and my touch found the hearts of all of Maple World.\r\n#L0##bThis feeling, this is my strength?#l\n#k
0.3: The Maple Alliance needs your power, all of it, to succeed. You must take this strength and learn to control it, for the good of us all. Otherwise, your life will fall to ruin. Will you prove yourself to me?

yes.0: Our bright future grows closer by the moment.

no.0: Why do you hesitate? Do not fear what lies inside you.
